name: penthera
description: The routine work of a security team, on your own machine. Audit a live URL and your repo, vet what your npm dependencies can do and block risky installs, audit your AI tooling (skills, MCP servers, hooks, plugins), fix what it finds on a local branch and re-scan to verify, and produce reports and NIS2 evidence. Offline, deterministic, no telemetry. Authorized testing only.
